title: Zesty Garlicky Canadian Fennel Skillet
description: A light and flavorful Canadian dish featuring fennel, garlic, and a hint of citrus, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dairy-free friendly recipe is easy to make and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the katsuramuki-cut fennel and cook for 5 minutes, or until it starts to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the fennel and garlic, and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and chili flakes.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the fennel is tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
